title: Ancient Computer Found in a Sunken Rusty Lump?

segments.text: What if a rusted lump was an ancient computer?
You hear about a 2nd‑century BC Greek device that predicts eclipses decades ahead.
It sits in a wooden case about 34 cm by 18 cm by 9 cm.
Inside, 35 bronze gears mesh, thirty still visible.
The gears model the Moon’s irregular orbit, a trick first described by Hipparchus.
X‑ray scans revealed the gear train and faint inscriptions.
The device could forecast Sun and Moon positions far into the future.
So that rusted lump was an ancient computer.
